verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents official mobile SDKs (self-contained libraries with instructions/examples/project files) alongside a REST API, but evidence is limited to mobile SDKs rather than broad language SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Java) typically expected for AI-native agent integration. missing for 10: language-specific SDK repos/package listings, code samples showing SDK usage, evidence of maintenance/versioning or community adoption of the SDKs.
